headline: Recertified Fire Captain eligibility list for six months, tabled Records Technician job description, and removed a Deputy Fire Marshall candidate from its list.
summary: Members removed one candidate from a Deputy Fire Marshall list and recertified a Fire Captain eligibility list for six months. They tabled a Records Technician job description to a later date. Staff discussed NeoGov, a new electronic system for reviewing civil service applications.
decisions: Approved the July 21, 2026 regular meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved removing one Deputy Fire Marshall candidate from Certified Eligibility List # 26-14, unanimously.
Tabled review and approval of the Records Technician job description to a later date, unanimously.
Approved recertifying eligibility list #25-19 for Fire Captain for an additional six months, unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
9:00 AM, August 4, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 9:00 AM 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward, Andrea Lobo 
Staff in attendance: Director of Human Resources, Jordanne Bryan-Haynes, Administrative 
Assistant, J. Susy Diaz-Callands. 
Officer Michael White, Chief of Police, E.P. Reynolds.  
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Regular Meeting Minutes from 7.21.2026  
  Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the July 21st, 2026 regular meeting 
minutes. 
 
Commissioner Andrews Seconded the motion. 
Motion Passes unanimously. 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 None.  
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 None. 
6. ACTION ITEMS   
 
 
 1. Removal of one Deputy Fire Marshall Candidate from Certified Eligibility List (# 26-14) 
• A. Barletta (Code F)  
 
       
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to remove the candidate from the Deputy Fire 
Marshall Certified List #26-14.
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 2. Review and approval of the following job description: 
• Records Technician 
 
       
  Commissioner Lobo motioned to table the review and approval of the Records 
Technician job description to a later date.  
 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 3. Eligibility List Recertificaation:  
• List #25-19 Fire Captain 
 
       
  Commissioner Andews motioned to recertify eligibility list #25-19 for an additional six 
(6) more months.  
 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously. 
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None. 
8. REPORTS   
 None. 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
Update on Civil Service Applicant tracking process.  
 Discussion held regarding the new electronic application system NeoGov for the 
commissioners to use to review and approve civil service applications.  
10. NEW BUSINESS   
 None. 
11. ADJOURNMENT   
 Commissioner Lobo motioned to adjourn at 9:09 AM. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
Motion passes unanimously.
